corePassives.description: Techniques, or Counterattacks, he launches 4 different types of Cero at enemies: Cero Combo - Basic attack, Cero Combo - Special Attack, Cero Combo - Technique, and Cero Combo - Counter. Each Cero activates its corresponding Cero Mark. When all 4 Cero Marks are activated, the technique is enhanced. After every 2 releases of Cero Combo - Special Attack, Ulquiorra can actively release 1 counterattack, which deals 50% less damage. If Ulquiorra's basic attacks, Unsheathed and Blade Pursuit, or the technique, Heavy Pressure, are used at the right moment, they can block enemy attacks.
corePassives.name: Cero Mark

corePassives.description: For each Cero Mark Ulquiorra consumes, his ATK is increased by 3.5% for 25 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times.
corePassives.name: Nihility

corePassives.description: Whenever Ulquiorra releases a Cero, increases the next Ultimate DMG by 10%, stacking up to 8 times, with an extra 20% increase at full stacks.
corePassives.name: Void

corePassives.description:
